description: This is a unit test class for the LeavePeriodService within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It contains test methods to verify the functionality of getting list of months, dates, current leave period, normalized leave period data, and leave period end date calculations.

classes.name: LeavePeriodServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the functionalities of LeavePeriodService within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: testGetListOfMonths
methods.description: Validates that the method returns the correct list of month names.

methods.name: testGetListOfDates
methods.description: Validates the date ranges returned for each month, including handling of leap years and invalid inputs.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Checks that the DAO object returned is an instance of LeavePeriodDao.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the current leave period start date and month, including cache behavior and null results.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodWhenNotDefined
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no leave period is configured.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Checks retrieving the current leave period based on current date understanding.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Verifies normalization of the current leave period data.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDateWhenLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when leave period is not defined.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Tests calculation of the maximum allowed leave period end date based on different start dates and current date.
